nodes.label: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Barrel entry points can re-export up to 10,000 modules, costing 200-800ms per import on every cold start. Tree-shaking does not rescue this: an external package cannot be optimized, and bundling it to enable tree-shaking makes builds much slower. Trade-off called out: deep direct imports break types for libraries like lucide-react that ship no .d.ts for subpaths, so optimizePackageImports is preferred where available.

nodes.label: experimental.optimizePackageImports
nodes.rationale: Next.js 13.5+ build-time transform that rewrites barrel imports to direct ones, keeping TypeScript types and autocomplete while removing the barrel cost; credited with 15-70% faster dev boot, 28% faster builds and 40% faster cold starts.
